The only difference from the spec is that every reference designator has been renumbered (U5->U9, J1->J2, Q1->Q2, Q2->Q3, U4->U10, IC1->IC2, L1->L2, L2->L3, R1->R3, S1->S2, etc.); this is a naming/ordering convention that does not change electrical behaviour and is explicitly excluded, so no anomaly is reported.
